create_nodemap: create a NodeMap instance to manage AsyncNodes with an optional chunk store factory
get_asyncnode: get an AsyncNode from the NodeMap by its node ID string
extract_asyncnode: extract and remove an AsyncNode from the NodeMap by its node ID
check_contains: check if the NodeMap contains an AsyncNode with a given node ID
access_asyncnode: access an AsyncNode from the NodeMap using bracket notation by node ID
